purpose: Resolve categorical reference levels and numerical conventions without changing the frozen 100-column raw feature registry.
why_these_references: Each is a deterministic first/best-defined level from the preregistered category ordering. No outcome frequency, coefficient, or model-performance information was inspected to select it.

continuous_conventions.risk_year_age_reference: 12:00:00 UTC on July 1 of the calendar risk year
continuous_conventions.age_younger: minimum of the two exact-birth-JD ages at the risk-year age reference
continuous_conventions.age_older: maximum of the two exact-birth-JD ages at the risk-year age reference
continuous_conventions.calendar_year_centered_squared: square of centered calendar year before standardization

standardization.continuous_columns: training-fold mean and standard deviation only
standardization.constant_continuous_column: map to all zeros after training-fold centering; never drop selectively
standardization.zero_variance_binary_column: retain as raw 0/1 column; it contributes no fitted information

pair_year_label_policy.event: 1 only on the final row of an accepted nonfatal-exit episode; 0 otherwise
pair_year_label_policy.censor_final_row: included as event=0 because the source-supported censor establishes survival without accepted nonfatal exit through that risk year
pair_year_label_policy.pair_equal_weight_sensitivity: separate frozen sensitivity only; primary likelihood uses ordinary pair-year rows

outer_split_component_policy.graph: nodes are ADB person IDs; edges are accepted modeled pairs
outer_split_component_policy.assignment: sort components by decreasing event-pair count, then decreasing pair-year row count, then lexicographic SHA-256 of sorted pair keys; assign to fold with fewest events, then fewest rows, then lowest fold index
outer_split_component_policy.inner_cv: same connected-component grouping restricted to outer-training components

forbidden: dropping a different categorical reference after seeing model performance
using full one-hot categorical groups together with an intercept in the fitted design
using outcome precision, endpoint source, or future censor type as predictors
arbitrary A/B ordering as a predictor
